## IDtsRollupConfig.untrimmedFilePath property

Path for untrimmed rollup (virtual path). Includes all declarations without any trimming.

**Signature:**

```typescript
untrimmedFilePath?: string;
```

## Remarks

If omitted, the untrimmed rollup will not be generated.
